name: motion-takayu-follow-chain
title: Tail Follow-through
description: Một chuỗi khớp như đuôi, tóc hay khăn lặp lại chuyển động của thân, trễ dần về phía ngọn, ngọn còn đung đưa khi thân đã dừng.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ch-tail, written here): A chain of 6 joints (tail, hair, scarf): joint i repeats the leader's motion delayed (i + 1) x 40-50 ms through a spring whose damping drops toward the tip (more overshoot at the end), plus a small wiggle growing toward the tip (~0.8 px x i). Segment thickness 8 px tapering 1 px per joint. Params: joints (6) · delay (40–50 ms / khớp) · wiggle (0.8 px / khớp). Each joint repeats the body's move later through a spring whose damping drops toward the tip, so the tip still swings after the body stops.
